items.exampleEn: The climber reached the top after ten hours.
items.exampleZh: 那位登山者十個小時後登上山頂。

items.exampleEn: She has done gymnastics since she was five.
items.exampleZh: 她五歲起就開始練體操。

items.exampleEn: Aerobics became popular about forty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 有氧運動大約在四十年前開始流行。

items.exampleEn: Diving in clear water is like flying.
items.exampleZh: 在清澈的水裡潛水就像在飛。

items.exampleEn: Jogging in the rain can be fun.
items.exampleZh: 在雨中慢跑也可以很有趣。

items.exampleEn: This snowboard is too long for a child.
items.exampleZh: 這塊滑雪板對小孩來說太長了。

items.exampleEn: The losing team showed great sportsmanship.
items.exampleZh: 輸球的那一隊展現了很好的運動家精神。

items.sentenceEn: Our school has a new gymnastics coach.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校來了一位新的體操教練。

items.audioEn: The aerobics class is now on Wednesday evenings instead of Monday mornings.
items.audioZh: 有氧課現在改在星期三晚上，不是星期一早上了。
items.questionZh: 有氧課現在什麼時候上？

items.sentenceEn: I go jogging with my dog every evening.
items.sentenceZh: 我每天傍晚帶狗去慢跑。

items.stemEn: She practices ____ in the school hall every afternoon.
items.stemZh: 她每天下午在學校禮堂練體操。

items.stemEn: ____ is my favorite way to stay fit; I run every morning.
items.stemZh: 慢跑是我最喜歡的健身方式，我每天早上都跑。

items.passageEn: Our sports club offers many activities. Climbers can practice on a high wall inside the building, and children can learn gymnastics on Saturdays. There is an aerobics class with loud music every evening. In winter, the club takes members to the mountains to snowboard, and in summer, it runs diving trips to a small island. An outdoor jogging group meets at six every morning. Above all, the coaches teach good sportsmanship.
items.passageZh: 我們的運動俱樂部提供很多活動。攀爬者可以在館內的高牆上練習，孩子們每週六可以學體操。每天晚上都有一堂配著大聲音樂的有氧課。冬天，俱樂部帶會員到山上玩滑雪板；夏天則舉辦到小島的潛水之旅。一個戶外慢跑團每天早上六點集合。最重要的是，教練們會教大家好的運動家精神。

questions.questionZh: 孩子們星期六可以學什麼？
戶外慢跑團什麼時候集合？

items.promptZh: 我爸爸年輕時很喜歡潛水。
referenceEn: My father loved diving when he was young.
When my dad was young, he really liked diving.
rubricZh: diving 表示「潛水」，例如 love diving、go diving 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 snowboard 造一個句子，說說你玩滑雪板的經驗或想法。
referenceEn: I want to learn to snowboard one day.
I tried to snowboard last winter, but I fell a lot.
rubricZh: snowboard 可當動詞「玩滑雪板」或名詞「滑雪板」，例如 learn to snowboard 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如過去式、現在式等）
